verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge stores its data in the developer's own configured storage provider, adding its own tables, and can be inspected locally via `mastra dev` and Studio. That points to self-hosted, in-app operation rather than a mandatory hosted service. However, the evidence never states that it runs fully offline, embedded in-process, or against local models. missing for 10: explicit embedded/in-process local storage option, local model/embedding support, statement of no cloud dependency, hands-on corroboration of offline operation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the memory layer fully locally — embedded in-process or against local models — without any cloud dependency

citations.quote: Knowledge is stored in your configured storage provider, which adds its own `mastra_knowledge_*` tables the first time Knowledge is used
To see the page, run `mastra dev`, open Studio and select **Knowledge**.
